settings.codPolicyTitle: COD Order Confirmation & Advance Shipping Protocol
settings.codPolicyNotice: Cash on Delivery is available for orders up to ₹500 (subject to phone/OTP verification). A nominal non-refundable handling fee of ₹50 applies. To verify intent & reserve courier dispatch, an advance shipping fee of ₹120 is required via UPI. Doorstep refusal blocks future COD privileges.
settings.codRefusalNotice: If a customer refuses a COD order at the doorstep, future COD facilities for that account will be blocked.
settings.exchangePolicyNotice: Exchange requests must be raised within 7 days of delivery. Items must be unwashed, unworn, and have original tags attached. Exchange for a different size or item of equal value. Strictly NO cash/monetary refunds under any circumstances. In case of manufacturing defects or wrong item received, an uncut, 360-degree unboxing video is mandatory within 24 hours of delivery.
